name: stranger-danger
description: Stranger Danger: flags instructions hidden in other people's content (Slack, Jira, MCP, web, gh) and asks before any external post that follows; your own messages and Claude's text are never scanned.

self.title: Your identities
self.description: Extra comma-separated identities. Your git name and email, gh login, and the Jira and Slack accounts the MCP servers are signed in as are detected by themselves.

trustedServers.title: Trusted MCP servers
trustedServers.description: Comma-separated MCP server names whose output is never scanned.

privateTerms.title: Private terms
privateTerms.description: Comma-separated strings that must never appear in an outbound post.
